appearances.snippet: She has a number of LLCs. And when I say a number, I mean it's almost incalculable the amount of LLCs trying to figure out what exactly this does, the technology, connections from France to Arizona to Cincinnati to Massachusetts.

verification.notes: Transcript alleges an almost incalculable set of LLC and technology ties across several locations. Arizona corporate records and Lori Frantzve's public professional profile confirm some corporate and technology roles, including Superfeed, but do not substantiate the sweeping quantity or every geographic connection asserted.
